description: The Communications tab has exactly 18 columns in the fixed production order, with ingress_fingerprint as column R.
why_it_exists: The replay resolver stores its digest in Communications.ingress_fingerprint. That column did not exist until this one-shot migration wrote the header cell Communications!R1 on 2026-08-21 via a raw Sheets PUT (valueInputOption=RAW), adding a column without touching a single data row. If the column is ever dropped, renamed or reordered, every replay silently reads a blank fingerprint and the resolver degrades to FINGERPRINT_NOT_RECORDED on every message.
assertions: Communications row 1 contains exactly 18 header cells.
The 18th header (column R) is exactly the string 'ingress_fingerprint'.

The first 17 headers appear in the order: communication_id, matter_id, action_id, direction, channel, provider_message_id, thread_id, recipient, subject, summary, classification, received_at, response_due, next_action, draft_id, approval_id, idempotency_key.
Adding the column must not append, delete or reorder any data row.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "invariant": not executed by harness/run.js.
